detections.name: Cloud Current Public Exposure Needs Review
detections.description: Detect current cloud resources with public internet exposure from the projected graph when no open exposure finding already anchors the resource.
false_positives: Approved exposure or trust path during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the exposed resource or trust path, linked principals, scope, and adjacent identity findings.

detections.name: Cloud Effective Admin Permission
detections.description: Detect effective cloud permissions that grant admin-equivalent actions.
false_positives: Approved exposure or trust path during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the exposed resource or trust path, linked principals, scope, and adjacent identity findings.

detections.name: Cloud Exposed Privileged Compute Role
detections.description: Detect publicly reachable cloud compute workloads that run as admin-equivalent or privilege-escalating identities.
false_positives: Approved public compute endpoint whose runtime role is intentionally broad and protected by compensating controls not yet modeled in the graph.
Temporary deployment or break-glass role attachment during a documented maintenance window.
detections.runbook: Validate the public entry point, remove unnecessary public ingress, and reduce the AWS role, GCP service account, or Azure managed identity to least privilege. For ECS services and tasks, review the linked task definition role first.

detections.name: Cloud Privilege Path Granted
detections.description: Detect cloud trust, impersonation, and application role paths that expand access.
false_positives: Approved exposure or trust path during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the exposed resource or trust path, linked principals, scope, and adjacent identity findings.

detections.name: Cloud Public Exposure With Privileged Principal
detections.description: Detect cloud accounts where public reachability and admin-equivalent permissions intersect.
false_positives: Approved public endpoint in an account where privileged access is intentionally restricted by compensating controls not yet modeled in the graph.
Transient deployment or bootstrap permissions during a documented maintenance window.
detections.runbook: Review the public endpoint/resource and privileged principal in the same cloud account. Remove public ingress where unnecessary, reduce the principal permission scope, and document approved exceptions.

detections.name: Cloud Public Resource Exposure
detections.description: Detect cloud resources with public internet exposure.
false_positives: Approved exposure or trust path during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the exposed resource or trust path, linked principals, scope, and adjacent identity findings.

detections.name: Data Sensitive Asset Risk
detections.description: Detect sensitive or crown-jewel data assets with public exposure or privileged access risk.
false_positives: Data classification is stale, test data is intentionally labeled sensitive, or public exposure is already approved by documented compensating controls.
detections.runbook: Validate the data classification, exposure signal, owner, and compensating controls.

detections.name: Email Domain Authentication Misconfigured
detections.description: Detect tenant mail domains whose SPF, DKIM, or DMARC configuration is missing, permissive, or non-enforcing and that can be abused for spoofing.
false_positives: DKIM selectors outside the probed defaults (or scoped to subdomains) may exist and not be discovered by the source.
Domains that intentionally do not send mail may legitimately omit SPF/DKIM/DMARC, but should publish a deny-all SPF and DMARC reject policy to stop spoofing.
detections.runbook: Inspect the failing_issue_codes attribute on the finding, address the most severe protocol gap first (SPF permissive/missing, DMARC missing or p=none, DKIM weak/missing), then confirm the source re-runs healthy and clears the finding.

detections.name: GitHub App Integration Installed
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Approved GitHub App onboarding through standard change management.
detections.runbook: Review installer, app publisher, requested permissions, repository scope, and revoke unauthorized installations.

detections.name: GitHub Code Security Controls Disabled
detections.description: Detect GitHub audit events where Dependabot, vulnerability alerts, secret scanning, or GitHub Advanced Security controls are disabled.
false_positives: Approved security control migration or temporary configuration rollback by authorized administrators.
detections.runbook: Confirm authorization, re-enable code security controls, review package and secret exposure during the disabled window, and inspect adjacent repository changes by the actor.

detections.name: GitHub Dependabot Open Alert
detections.description: Detect open GitHub Dependabot alerts replayed from one source runtime.
false_positives: Accepted risk or non-exploitable vulnerable dependency in a non-runtime path.
detections.runbook: Review affected package, advisory, vulnerable range, and repository usage; upgrade to the first patched version or document accepted risk.

detections.name: GitHub Organization Authentication Control Modified
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Planned identity provider migration or approved organization security policy update.
detections.runbook: Verify the owner action, review organization membership and token activity around the change, and restore SAML/2FA/OAuth restrictions if unauthorized.

detections.name: GitHub Organization IP Allow List Modified
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Approved network perimeter update or corporate egress address rotation.
detections.runbook: Validate the IP allow list change, remove unauthorized CIDRs, and correlate actor access from newly allowed networks.

detections.name: GitHub Organization Owner Needs Review
detections.description: Detect GitHub organization members with the owner role, which grants unrestricted administrative access including billing, membership, and security settings.
false_positives: Designated org owners with documented need for administrative access and active operational responsibilities.
detections.runbook: Validate each org owner has a documented business need for the owner role. Demote members to the member role where administrative access is not required. Ensure owner accounts have MFA and are not shared.

detections.name: GitHub Organization Owner Added
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Approved organization owner onboarding or break-glass access grant.
detections.runbook: Validate the new owner, revoke unauthorized access immediately, review owner activity, and require MFA/SSO re-verification.

detections.name: GitHub Personal Access Token Created
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Expected developer token creation following approved access request.
detections.runbook: Verify token owner, scopes, and source IP; revoke suspicious tokens and review git/API activity after creation.

detections.name: GitHub Private Repository Forking Enabled
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Approved policy change to support internal development workflows.
detections.runbook: Validate forking policy approval, disable unauthorized private forking, and enumerate forks created after the policy change.

detections.name: GitHub Programmatic Credential Needs Review
detections.description: Detect current GitHub programmatic credentials, integrations, OAuth apps, and credential authorizations that should have explicit ownership and review.
false_positives: Approved deploy keys, service accounts, or GitHub Apps with documented owner, scope, and rotation process.
detections.runbook: Confirm owner, scope, last-use/need, and rotation for the credential or integration; remove unused access or document the exception.

detections.name: GitHub Repository Collaborator Added
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Expected onboarding or approved repository access change.
detections.runbook: Confirm the collaborator is authorized, review their repository permissions, and inspect immediate repository activity after access was granted.

detections.name: GitHub Repository Ruleset Modified
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Approved repository governance migration or ruleset tuning.
detections.runbook: Review changed ruleset enforcement and bypass actors, restore required checks/reviews, and inspect protected branch activity.

detections.name: GitHub Secret Scanning Alert Created
detections.description: Detect open GitHub secret scanning alerts replayed from GitHub audit events.
false_positives: Canary tokens or expected test secrets in controlled repositories.
detections.runbook: Review the alert, revoke or rotate the exposed credential, and inspect commits, artifacts, and workflow logs for further exposure.

detections.name: GitHub Self-Hosted Runner Needs Review
detections.description: Retired GitHub runner review rule retained so noisy open findings can be cleaned up without recreating them.
false_positives: Approved persistent runner pools with documented owner, hardening baseline, and network isolation.
detections.runbook: Validate runner ownership, scope, host trust, ephemeral posture, and recent jobs; remove or isolate unauthorized runners.

detections.name: GitHub Webhook Modified
detections.description: Retired GitHub audit-mirror rule retained so stale open findings auto-resolve; durable coverage moved to posture findings.
false_positives: Approved integration onboarding or webhook maintenance.
detections.runbook: Verify webhook destination and events, remove unauthorized hooks, and rotate secrets if repository data may have been sent externally.

detections.name: Open Finding Isolated From Resources
detections.description: Detect open finding anchors that have no graph resource relationship.
false_positives: Resolved or suppressed historical finding anchors may intentionally remain without active resource links.
detections.runbook: Check why the rule emitted no ResourceURNs for an open finding, fix the rule projection context, or resolve stale anchors.

detections.name: AWS EC2 ENI Link Missing
detections.description: Detect AWS network interface public-endpoint nodes that name an EC2 instance but lack the graph link to that instance.
false_positives: The referenced EC2 instance may have been terminated between endpoint and instance inventory snapshots.
detections.runbook: Backfill or fix the public endpoint projection so ENIs are linked to their attached or associated EC2 instance.

detections.name: Graph Orphan Non-Finding Node
detections.description: Detect non-finding graph nodes with no relationships, indicating source projection or enrichment gaps.
false_positives: Some source records may intentionally be inventory-only and not yet connected to the rest of the graph.
detections.runbook: Review the source projection for the entity type and add ownership, source, identity, or resource relations where appropriate.

detections.name: Graph Resource Has Multiple Open Findings
detections.description: Detect resources with multiple active findings so remediation can be coordinated by shared resource rather than by individual alert.
false_positives: Multiple findings may be duplicate projections of one upstream issue until deduplication rules converge.
detections.runbook: Prioritize the shared resource, group the findings by rule and owner, and remediate the common root cause.

detections.name: GRC Control Missing Evidence Coverage
detections.description: Detect GRC controls that have an owner but no linked control-test evidence in the graph.
false_positives: The control may be manually assessed outside Vanta or intentionally not test-backed.
detections.runbook: Confirm whether the control should have automated or manual test evidence, then map the control test or document the accepted exception.

detections.name: GRC Control Test Needs Attention
detections.description: Detect provider-neutral GRC control tests that are failing or need attention.
false_positives: Provider status lag, manual compensating control already accepted, or test scope intentionally excluded by risk acceptance.
detections.runbook: Review the control test evidence, confirm the owner and exception state, remediate failed controls, and record risk acceptance where appropriate.

detections.name: GRC Document Needs Owner Or Upload
detections.description: Detect GRC document records that still need a document upload or lack an accountable owner.
false_positives: Some document placeholders may intentionally track future evidence collection.
detections.runbook: Assign an owner for the document, upload the missing evidence, or close the placeholder if the document is no longer required.

detections.name: Failing GRC Control Has Open Operational Findings
detections.description: Detect failing provider-neutral GRC control tests that map to open non-GRC operational findings through shared control references.
false_positives: GRC control test has already been remediated but the latest passing test result has not synced yet.
Operational finding control references are too broad and do not represent the failing test's exact control objective.
detections.runbook: Review the failing GRC control test, inspect the linked open operational findings, remediate the underlying technical issues, then rerun or resync the GRC control test.

detections.name: GRC Failing Control Test On Unhealthy Integration
detections.description: Detect failing GRC control-test evidence that belongs to an integration with disabled or errored connections.
false_positives: The integration error count may be stale if the upstream GRC provider has not refreshed connection status yet.
detections.runbook: Repair the unhealthy source integration, rerun the failing control test, and verify whether the control failure clears once evidence collection is healthy.

detections.name: Inactive GRC Identity Still Has Active Access
detections.description: Detect provider-neutral GRC people or users marked inactive whose email identity still bridges to active access or privileged accounts in connected systems.
false_positives: Break-glass or service account intentionally retained after offboarding with a documented exception.
GRC roster or identity provider sync lag immediately after a lifecycle change.
detections.runbook: Confirm the person is inactive in the authoritative GRC roster, revoke or suspend the bridged account in the connected system, rotate credentials created by the account, and record any approved exception.

detections.name: GRC Target Enrichment Gap
detections.description: Detect GRC vulnerable-asset targets that are isolated and therefore cannot coordinate to assets, sources, vulnerabilities, or packages.
false_positives: Some upstream targets may be placeholders that intentionally lack asset, integration, or vulnerability references.
detections.runbook: Inspect the upstream vulnerable asset payload and add host, IP, platform resource, integration, vulnerability, or package fields so the target can be coordinated.

detections.name: Overdue GRC Vulnerability Still Present On Assets
detections.description: Detect provider-neutral GRC vulnerability SLAs that are overdue while non-GRC scanners still show the canonical vulnerability or package present on assets.
false_positives: GRC remediation deadline was extended but the updated deadline has not synced yet.
Scanner finding is stale and the asset has already been patched, but the non-GRC source has not synced the fixed state yet.
detections.runbook: Confirm the scanner evidence is current, prioritize remediation of the affected assets or packages, and update the GRC vulnerability record once the live scanner evidence is gone.

detections.name: Privileged Account Missing GRC Person
detections.description: Detect privileged human accounts in connected systems that do not have a fresh email-backed bridge to any provider-neutral GRC person or user record.
false_positives: Privileged break-glass account intentionally excluded from the GRC people roster with a documented compensating control.
Recently onboarded employee whose GRC people sync has not completed yet.
detections.runbook: Validate the privileged account owner, add or correct the GRC people record so it carries the account owner's email, or revoke the privilege if no accountable owner exists.

detections.name: GRC Source Integration Concentrated Open Findings
detections.description: Detect GRC source integrations that accumulate many active findings and should be prioritized as a coordinated remediation surface.
false_positives: Multiple findings may represent duplicate upstream vulnerability records on the same integration.
The source integration may be intentionally broad and owned by an active remediation program.
detections.runbook: Review the integration owner, cluster the active findings by vulnerability and target, and drive remediation at the source integration level rather than ticketing each duplicate individually.

detections.name: GRC Vendor Review Overdue
detections.description: Detect provider-neutral GRC vendors with overdue security reviews or missing owners.
false_positives: Vendor review has an approved deferral, owner is tracked outside the provider, or provider sync has not reflected the latest review.
detections.runbook: Confirm vendor owner and review status, request updated security review evidence, and document exceptions or offboarding decisions.

detections.name: GRC Vulnerability SLA Overdue
detections.description: Detect provider-neutral GRC vulnerabilities that are past remediation deadline.
false_positives: SLA clock is paused by approved exception, asset is decommissioned, or vulnerability is already remediated but provider sync has not completed.
detections.runbook: Confirm the vulnerability is fixable and in scope, validate remediation deadline and asset ownership, then prioritize patching or exception review.

detections.name: Identity Admin Privilege Granted
detections.description: Detect admin-role or delegated-admin grants in identity providers.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Identity API Token Or OAuth App Created
detections.description: Detect API token creation, OAuth application authorization, or domain-wide delegation changes.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Identity Auth Control Lifecycle Tampering
detections.description: Detect identity-provider authentication, policy, network-zone, IdP, and security-setting control changes.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Identity External Or Personal Group Member
detections.description: Detect group memberships tied to personal or external email domains.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Active GitHub Identity With No Linked Okta Identity
detections.description: Detect GitHub accounts acting on repositories or organization resources whose identifiers do not bridge to any Okta user in the same tenant, indicating shadow access that bypasses the corporate IdP.
false_positives: External contributor not represented in the corporate IdP whose access is governed by repository-level controls.
Recently created GitHub user observed before the next Okta inventory sync; the gap should close inside one sync cycle.
Service or automation account intentionally retained outside Okta with documented exception (e.g. break-glass, deploy bot).
detections.runbook: Confirm whether the GitHub account belongs to a current employee, link it to the corresponding Okta identity (or onboard the user into Okta), or remove the account's access if it is not authorized.

detections.name: Identity MFA Factor Reset Or Disabled
detections.description: Detect source-backed MFA/2SV posture gaps for Okta, Google Workspace, and GCP service-account identities; AWS IAM and Azure user MFA posture require source-adapter extensions before this rule claims those providers.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Okta Authenticator Weak Factor Enabled
detections.description: Detect active Okta authenticators using phishing-susceptible factor types such as SMS, voice call, or email, which weaken org-wide MFA posture.
false_positives: Org intentionally enables SMS/voice as a fallback for users who cannot use hardware tokens or mobile apps.
detections.runbook: Review the active authenticator and migrate users to phishing-resistant factors (FIDO2/WebAuthn, Okta Verify with push). Disable weak factors once migration is complete.

detections.name: Deprovisioned Okta Identity Still Has Cloud Access
detections.description: Detect Okta identities marked deprovisioned, suspended, or inactive whose email-backed cloud/SaaS principal still has recent activity or privileged access.
false_positives: Break-glass account intentionally retained during offboarding with a documented, time-bound exception.
Identity-provider or cloud-inventory sync lag immediately after a lifecycle transition.
detections.runbook: Confirm the Okta identity is offboarded, revoke the linked cloud/SaaS principal or its privileged grants, rotate credentials created by the account, and document any approved exception.

detections.name: Deprovisioned Okta Identity Still Active In GitHub
detections.description: Detect Okta identities marked deprovisioned, suspended, or inactive whose linked GitHub account is still acting on repositories or organization resources.
false_positives: Delayed Okta lifecycle propagation immediately after a status change; window typically closes within one sync cycle.
Service or break-glass account intentionally retained in GitHub during an off-boarding grace window with documented exception.
detections.runbook: Confirm the Okta identity is truly off-boarded, revoke or suspend the linked GitHub account, rotate any tokens it created, and document the gap that allowed continued access.

detections.name: Okta OAuth Or Public Client Needs Review
detections.description: Detect active Okta OAuth/OIDC applications and public-client actors that should have owner, grant, and scope review.
false_positives: Approved first-party Okta clients, documented public clients, or applications reviewed by identity/security.
detections.runbook: Validate app owner, OAuth grants, public-client status, redirect URIs, assignments, and whether the client is still needed.

detections.name: Okta Policy Rule Lifecycle Tampering
detections.description: Detect Okta policy rules that remain deactivated, disabled, or inactive in projected identity state.
false_positives: Authorized identity platform administration during approved change windows.
detections.runbook: Review actor, target policy rule, administrative change ticket, and adjacent identity events before reverting or escalating.

detections.name: Okta ThreatInsight Not Blocking
detections.description: Detect Okta ThreatInsight configuration that is set to audit-only or disabled, leaving the org without automated brute-force and credential-stuffing protection.
false_positives: Org intentionally running ThreatInsight in audit mode during initial rollout or policy evaluation period.
detections.runbook: Review ThreatInsight configuration and set action to 'block' to enable automated brute-force protection. Verify exclude zones are intentional.

detections.name: Identity Privileged Account Without MFA
detections.description: Detect source-backed privileged identity accounts that are not enrolled in MFA/2SV; AWS IAM and Azure user MFA posture require source-adapter extensions before this rule claims those users.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Identity Privileged No-MFA Account With Sensitive Access
detections.description: Detect source-backed privileged no-MFA identities that currently have access to crown-jewel or sensitive classified resources in the graph; AWS IAM and Azure user MFA posture require source-adapter extensions before those user entity types are included.
false_positives: Break-glass identity with approved compensating controls and time-bound exception.
Resource incorrectly tagged as crown-jewel or sensitive classification in the graph.
detections.runbook: Enroll MFA for the identity or remove its privileged access to the sensitive resource. Validate the resource classification/tag and revoke any stale access edge in the identity or cloud provider.

detections.name: Identity Stale Privileged Account
detections.description: Detect privileged identity accounts with stale or missing login activity.
false_positives: Approved identity administration during a documented change window.
detections.runbook: Review the actor, identity target, linked graph identities, and adjacent findings by the same actor or shared identifier.

detections.name: Runtime Active Threat Evidence
detections.description: Detect confirmed runtime evidence of active exploitation, credential access, or suspicious execution.
false_positives: Approved red-team activity, vulnerability scanner behavior, or expected administrative automation with matching change evidence.
detections.runbook: Review the workload, process, credential access, linked finding, and runtime evidence before containment.

detections.name: Security Reviewer Reported Finding
detections.description: Represent validated security-reviewer output as deterministic finding records for candidate review and promotion.
false_positives: Reviewer output that is advisory-only, already mitigated by changed code, or not exploitable after manual validation.
detections.runbook: Validate the reviewer evidence against the changed code, confirm exploitability and remediation owner, then promote or reject the candidate finding.

detections.name: SentinelOne Agent Detect Only Mode
detections.description: Detect endpoints where SentinelOne is configured to detect but not block or protect.
false_positives: Approved security testing, decommissioned endpoint, documented exception, or SentinelOne false positive reviewed by security.
detections.runbook: Review SentinelOne endpoint state, linked threat/activity evidence, policy scope, and documented exceptions before remediation or closure.

detections.name: SentinelOne Agent Not Up To Date
detections.description: Detect active SentinelOne agents whose protection agent version is not up to date.
false_positives: Endpoint is in a documented rollout ring, maintenance window, or decommissioning workflow not yet reflected in inventory.
detections.runbook: Update the SentinelOne agent, confirm policy assignment, or document a temporary exception for the endpoint rollout ring.

detections.name: SentinelOne Agent Stale
detections.description: Detect active inventory endpoints whose SentinelOne agent has not checked in recently.
false_positives: Approved security testing, decommissioned endpoint, documented exception, or SentinelOne false positive reviewed by security.
detections.runbook: Review SentinelOne endpoint state, linked threat/activity evidence, policy scope, and documented exceptions before remediation or closure.

detections.name: SentinelOne Endpoint Active Infection
detections.description: Detect endpoint-level active infection state from SentinelOne without mirroring each threat as a finding.
false_positives: Approved security testing, decommissioned endpoint, documented exception, or SentinelOne false positive reviewed by security.
detections.runbook: Review SentinelOne endpoint state, linked threat/activity evidence, policy scope, and documented exceptions before remediation or closure.

detections.name: Infected SentinelOne Endpoint Owned By Privileged Identity
detections.description: Detect active SentinelOne endpoint infection evidence where the endpoint owner resolves to a privileged identity in a connected control plane.
false_positives: Endpoint owner metadata is stale and no longer represents the current assignee.
Privileged role is break-glass only and disabled by compensating controls with documented exception.
detections.runbook: Prioritize containment of the infected endpoint, validate the owner identity's privileged grants, revoke or constrain active sessions, and rotate credentials used from the host.

detections.name: SentinelOne Mitigation Failed
detections.description: Detect SentinelOne containment or mitigation workflows that failed or require manual action.
false_positives: Approved security testing, decommissioned endpoint, documented exception, or SentinelOne false positive reviewed by security.
detections.runbook: Review SentinelOne endpoint state, linked threat/activity evidence, policy scope, and documented exceptions before remediation or closure.

detections.name: SentinelOne Protection Control Tampering
detections.description: Detect SentinelOne agents where a named protection control remains in a tampered state.
false_positives: Approved security testing, decommissioned endpoint, documented exception, or SentinelOne false positive reviewed by security.
detections.runbook: Review SentinelOne endpoint state, linked threat/activity evidence, policy scope, and documented exceptions before remediation or closure.

detections.name: SentinelOne Risky Exclusion
detections.description: Detect SentinelOne exclusions that are not recommended or materially broaden endpoint protection bypass scope.
false_positives: Approved security testing, decommissioned endpoint, documented exception, or SentinelOne false positive reviewed by security.
detections.runbook: Review SentinelOne endpoint state, linked threat/activity evidence, policy scope, and documented exceptions before remediation or closure.

detections.name: SentinelOne Unmitigated Threat
detections.description: Detect current SentinelOne threats that remain unresolved or not mitigated in the projected graph.
false_positives: Benign or false-positive verdicts not yet synchronized into the graph.
detections.runbook: Review the SentinelOne incident, mitigation status, endpoint context, and analyst verdict; mitigate or mark benign in SentinelOne.

detections.name: VulnView Actionable External Finding
detections.description: Detect open VulnView external attack-surface findings that require AppSec triage.
false_positives: Finding is a duplicate, asset is intentionally exposed with compensating controls, or scanner severity was manually downgraded after validation.
detections.runbook: Validate exploitability and asset ownership, link duplicate external findings, patch or mitigate the exposed service, and document accepted risk.

detections.name: VulnView External Asset Concentrated Signal
detections.description: Aggregate VulnView graph evidence to prioritize external assets with medium-or-higher or repeated attack-surface signals.
false_positives: External asset is intentionally exposed and covered by compensating controls.
Multiple scanner signals represent duplicates for the same vulnerability instance.
detections.runbook: Prioritize the external asset owner, validate the highest severity evidence, deduplicate repeated findings, and remediate or accept the aggregate risk.
